question: Does sequence-aware linear-chain CRF decoding over the frozen gidi-finance-v1 representation fix value-span continuity (boundary truncation) while type/target stay exactly v1?
out_of_scope: transformer layers, BiLSTM, adapters, encoder/type/target fine-tuning, independent token CE (or any auxiliary loss), hard BIO transition constraints, loss weighting, new/duplicated/augmented data, label changes, hyperparameter sweep, numeric normalization

base_model.note: the PyTorch checkpoint gidi-finance-v1 was frozen from (models/gidi-finance-v1/manifest.json sources.checkpoint_model_safetensors); loaded as trained, never re-initialised
base_model.identical_across_runs: every value-head seed loads the same base weights; checked by sha256 of the frozen state before and after training

architecture.frozen: every encoder parameter, type head, target BIO head (requires_grad False)
architecture.trainable: value path only: emissions Linear(768,256) -> GELU -> Dropout(0.1) -> Linear(256,3) (197,635 params, identical to v4) + linear-chain CRF over O / B-VALUE / I-VALUE: start_transitions [3], end_transitions [3], transitions [3,3] (15 params); 197,650 total; head arch `mlp-crf`
architecture.init: both Linear layers as v4: PyTorch default Linear init from private generators seeded VALUE_HEAD_SEED_BASE (1_000_003) + seed and + seed + 1_000_000; CRF transitions uniform(-0.1, 0.1) (pytorch-crf init) from a private generator seeded VALUE_HEAD_SEED_BASE + seed + 2_000_000
architecture.crf: standard linear-chain CRF, learned transitions only, no hard BIO constraints; the sequence is the real (non-special, non-empty-offset) tokens of a note, which are exactly the value-label positions; <s>/</s> excluded
architecture.decoding: Viterbi path over the real tokens (special tokens O), then the unchanged value span rule (value_decode.decode_all_spans) and best-span choice; span confidence still the geometric mean of softmax(emission) probabilities of the Viterbi tags (only matters when the path holds more than one span)
architecture.outputs: type_logits [batch, 8], target_logits [batch, seq, 3], value_logits = CRF emission scores [batch, seq, 3]
architecture.mode: encoder, type head, target head and the model's shared dropout run in eval mode throughout; only the value head is in train mode during training (its internal dropout active), eval mode at evaluation

pre_training_checks: optimizer param groups contain exactly the value-head parameters (4 emission tensors + 3 CRF tensors), nothing else
after the first backward pass every frozen parameter has grad None (or all zero)
frozen state sha256 equals the base checkpoint's before training, after the last epoch and in the saved checkpoint

data.validation: validation.jsonl (149), sha256 eef077c97a519dc532112683f3ab35daeaa6e55187c3c2fb01f53a0ee37f629c; logged per epoch only, never used for selection
data.test: test.jsonl (143 = 105 v1 + 38 targeted-value-01), sha256 acaca8d767828e48954e91871886ac191a45110af695af7df7573a9c0be6f91d; evaluation only
data.value_supervision: value loss only on value_status == complete; uncertain value labels masked

training.loss: value CRF negative log-likelihood only, mean over the notes of the batch with value_status == complete; uncertain notes masked (excluded); no token cross-entropy or other term
training.recipe: AdamW lr 1e-3 (emissions and CRF), weight decay 0.01 on the two Linear weight matrices and 0 on biases and CRF transitions, batch 8, 40 epochs, linear warmup 0.1 then linear decay, max grad norm 1.0 (value head incl. CRF), head dropout 0.1, per-epoch shuffle seeded by seed + epoch
training.rationale: identical head-level settings to v4 so the only change is the CRF objective and Viterbi decoding; chosen before training, no sweep
training.seed_meaning: value-head (MLP + CRF) initialisation and batch order only; base weights identical

export_seed: value-head seed 1; this experiment does not export (A means stop and report)

evaluation.invariance: for every test (143, incl. the 105 frozen v1 test records) and probe (81) record, and for every value-head seed: type logits, type prediction, target logits, target BIO prediction and target span equal the base v1 checkpoint's (CPU, same inputs; logits compared with max abs diff, required 0 on CPU; predictions/spans exactly equal). Also cross-checked against the frozen v1 seed-1 predictions in experiments/value-span-v1/eval/v1-seed1-*-predictions.jsonl
evaluation.value: same metric code, sets, slices and value-quality criteria as value-span-v1 / v3 / v4 (value_gate.value_quality_criteria), value spans from Viterbi decoding: mean over seeds and seed 1. Reported: value exact, span F1, token F1, human-only exact, present/null, slices explicit_unit, bare_number, multi_number, slang, unaccented, unseen_span, long_multi_token
evaluation.error_categories: every wrong value on complete labels (test, probe, per seed) classified by span position: wrong-number selection (no overlap), boundary truncation (inside gold), left overrun, right overrun into date/time, right overrun punctuation-only, other right overrun, missed (null)
evaluation.inspection: every multi-number value error on test and probe listed and inspected by hand
evaluation.tracked_cases: report only, never used for training or tuning: `cho a Nam vay 1 triệu 20/10` (gold `1 triệu`) and `Thắng vay 5 củ, hẹn t10 trả` (gold `5 củ`)
evaluation.comparison: error-category counts per seed and value metrics compared directly against value-span-v4-nonlinear-head; main question: does the CRF substantially reduce boundary truncation (v4: 15 / 15 / 15 on test, 6 / 6 / 7 on probe)

value_slices: unseen exact surface span vs train
long/multi-token amounts (>2 v1 tokens or containing a space)

adoption_criteria.type_target: type and target predictions identical to gidi-finance-v1 (base checkpoint) on every test-v1 and probe record (test-targeted and full test also reported); any difference is an implementation failure
value_quality: test value exact (complete labels, mean over seeds) >= 0.95
test value exact on human-provenance labels >= 0.90
no value slice with n >= 5 on test below 0.80 exact

verdict.A: invariance passes and all value-quality criteria pass: stop and report success; no export in this experiment
verdict.B: invariance passes, value quality fails: stop; no BiLSTM, transformer layers, adapters or unfreezing
verdict.C: invariance fails: implementation bug; fix only the bug and rerun

known_limitations: most value labels are rule-provenance accepted by stratum audit (0 errors in sampled strata); value metrics on them measure agreement with audited rule labels, so the human-only slice is reported separately
slices are small on test (xi 2, chai 3, lit 1, ty 0, bare 6); slice results are directional
test has 0 complete no_amount labels; null-value accuracy is measured on validation (2) and is not an adoption gate
2 trieu ruoi form is absent from all splits
the frozen v1 validation is in train, as in v1; only the 39 targeted-value-01 validation rows are held out
hypothesis: The frozen v1 features locate the amount (v4 MLP head: test value exact 0.863, present/null 1.0, wrong-number selection 1 per seed); the dominant remaining error is BIO span continuity / boundary truncation (15 per seed on test). A CRF over the same MLP emissions should enforce coherent spans.
